current.zh-CN: 当前步骤，从 0 开始计数；`dataSource` 项可用 status 覆盖状态。不可绑定，更新由使用方在 `onChange` 里写。
current.en-US: Current step, counting from 0; a `dataSource` item can override the state with status. Not bindable: update it yourself in `onChange`.

dataSource.zh-CN: 步骤数据，每项为 `StepData`：`status`（该步骤自己的状态，缺省时随 current 与 status 自动决定）、`title`、`description`（nav 类型不渲染）、`icon`（该步骤自定义图标的 snippet，`false` 不显示图标，缺省用状态图标；nav 类型不渲染）、`onClick`（设置后该步骤可点击），其余属性落在步骤根元素上。
dataSource.en-US: Step data. Each item is a `StepData`: `status` (own status of the step; when omitted it follows current and status), `title`, `description` (not rendered by the nav type), `icon` (snippet for a custom icon of that step; `false` shows no icon; the status icon is used when omitted; not rendered by the nav type) and `onClick` (setting it makes that step clickable). Other attributes land on the step's root element.

description.zh-CN: 每个步骤详情描述的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index }`；缺省时显示 `item.description`。nav 类型不渲染。
description.en-US: Snippet for the description of each step, with `{ item, index }`; defaults to `item.description`. Not rendered by the nav type.

hasLine.zh-CN: basic 类型是否显示连接线。
hasLine.en-US: Whether the basic type shows connecting lines.

initial.zh-CN: 起始序号，从 0 开始计数。

onChange.zh-CN: 点击或键盘选择步骤时调用，参数为该步骤序号（initial 加索引）；点击当前步骤不调用。传入后所有步骤变为可点击。
onChange.en-US: Called when a step is selected by click or keyboard, with its number (initial plus index); not called for the current step. Passing it makes every step clickable.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the root element.

size.zh-CN: basic 与 nav 类型的尺寸，可选 default、small。
size.en-US: Size of the basic and nav types: default or small.

status.zh-CN: 当前步骤的状态，可选 wait、process、finish、error、warning。
status.en-US: State of the current step: wait, process, finish, error or warning.

title.zh-CN: 每个步骤标题的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index }`；缺省时显示 `item.title`。
title.en-US: Snippet for the title of each step, with `{ item, index }`; defaults to `item.title`.

type.en-US: Steps type: fill, basic or nav.
